{{MultipleIssues|citation|expand}}
{{Quote|A starship is a weapon, but it's the rust that makes it deadly.|An old [[Spacer/Legends|spacer's]] line|<ref name="Precipice">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Precipice]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Fighters_PotJ.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The ''[[SunGem]]'' (left), a [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Jedi Starfighter]] (bottom right) and a [[Whitecloak fighter]] (top right)]]
A '''starship''', also known as a '''starcruiser''', '''spaceship''', '''spacecraft''', or simply just '''craft''' or '''ship''', was a vessel designed for [[The galaxy/Legends|interstellar]] travel, specifically between [[Star system/Legends|star systems]]. Starships were distinguished by the inclusion of a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], a piece of equipment that made [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] travel possible.

All starships had some sort of armored chassis built around the interior to protect it and the crew, as well as some sort of propulsion method such as a [[Sublight engine/Legends|Sublight engine]] or [[Ion engine/Legends|Ion engine]]. Starships often made use of additional components both internally and externally to add or enhance certain functions such as [[Capacitor/Legends|Capacitors]], [[Sensor/Legends|Sensors]], [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|Deflector Shields]], and weapon systems like [[Laser turret/Legends|Laser turrets]] or [[Missile/Legends|Missile launchers]].

==Propulsion==
[[The galaxy/Legends|Interstellar]] flight became possible with the invention of the [[dual-drive system]]. Starships used [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight drives]] to leave a [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Gravity well/Legends|gravity well]] and the [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] to travel between [[Star/Legends|stars]] faster than [[Lightspeed/Legends|light speed]].

Plotting a course to a star system was a highly complex operation. Calculations to travel at light speed were left up to a [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]] or [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]].

A common sublight drive was the [[Ion engine/Legends|ion engine]], which had a high power-to-weight ratio, and was used in [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] and [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]].

==Armament==
Certain vessels were armed with [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] emplacements, or missile launchers. Some were equipped with [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]], countering the effects of laser weaponry, thus protecting the ship from attack and asteroid impacts. Larger ships also acted as carriers, transporting dozens or hundreds of fighters for combat operations.

==Crew==
A small, single-person fighter, such as the [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]], could be flown by one pilot, with the help of an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]]. Larger vessels, like the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyers]], were crewed by thousands of personnel, who were responsible for ongoing maintenance and operations. In times of dire need, these Super Star Destroyers were equipped with a mere skeleton crew (the bare minimum necessary for all systems to be fully operational.) until such a time as a larger crew can be attained. Larger ships also had a [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]], the command center.

==Starship types==
[[File:JtypeStarSkiff-TCWs2BR1.png|thumb|right|250px|A J-type star skiff, a type of yacht]]
*[[Bomber/Legends|Bomber]] &mdash; A slower ship armed with bombs.
*[[Capital ship/Legends|Capital ship]] &mdash; The largest of starships, often used as a warship.
*[[Freighter/Legends|Freighter]] &mdash; A cargo or freight carrier.
*[[Gunship/Legends|Gunship]] &mdash; Used for atmospheric or space combat.
*[[Patrol ship/Legends|System patrol craft]] &mdash; Used for in-system operations; usually lacked hyperdrives.
*[[Scout ship/Legends|Scout vessel]] &mdash; A small, fast ship used to scout an area before a main force arrives.
*[[Space station/Legends|Space station]] &mdash; An artificial structure for use in orbit or deep space.
*[[Shuttle/Legends|Shuttle]] &mdash; A small craft used to transport personnel, usually at least partially though space.
*[[Starfighter/Legends|Starfighter]] &mdash; A small one- or two-man vessel typically used for [[Starfighter combat/Legends|dogfighting]].
*[[Transport/Legends|Transport]] &mdash; A cargo or passenger carrier.
*[[Yacht/Legends|Yacht]] &mdash; A luxurious vessel typically owned by a politician, diplomat or rich person.
